Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.gwc

Class GwcBlobStoreManager

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.AbstractManager
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.gwc.GwcBlobStoreManager
public class GwcBlobStoreManager extends AbstractManager
GeoWebCache (GWC) BlobStore REST API client.

Source: geowebcache/rest/src/main/java/org/geowebcache/rest/controller/BlobStoreController.java
GeoServer integrated GWC path: /geoserver/gwc/rest/blobstores

Endpoints (4)


 [1] GET    /gwc/rest/blobstores              list all blob stores          200
 [2] GET    /gwc/rest/blobstores/{name}       get blob store details        200 / 404
 [3] PUT    /gwc/rest/blobstores/{name}       create or update (upsert)     200 / 201
 [4] DELETE /gwc/rest/blobstores/{name}       delete blob store             200 / 404 / 500

Note: POST does not exist; creation is also done via PUT.

GET [1] observed behavior (2026-07-29): returns a plain string array ["probe1"] — not {name, href} objects.

Deleting the default BlobStore: DELETE on the default BlobStore causes 500 ConfigurationException [server-verified].

Only FileBlobStore is supported here — see GwcFileBlobStore. PUT always uses XML (JSON PUT triggers an XStream 500).
